title.tr: Annem Alman, babam Yunan: diller, uyruklar, aile
title.en: My mother's German, my father's Greek: languages, nationalities, family

cast.name: Ada
cast.manner: warm, curious, explains with Turkish bridges

cast.name: Mert
cast.manner: easy-going, a bit lazy, the learner; guesses and sometimes gets it wrong

cast.name: Κατερίνα
cast.manner: native, from Thessaloniki, warm, patient, clear

cast.name: Ελένη
cast.manner: Ayşe's neighbour in Athens, chatty, cheerful, warm; grew up with Greek and German

cast.name: Αϊσέ
cast.manner: Turkish learner of Greek from Izmir, a little shy, polite
